topics.title: Environment
topics.summary: Choose the software image and available service definitions.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the software image and available service definitions.
topics.behavior: This references a shared Environment, not a private copy. Execution target and resource size are selected separately.
topics.defaultBehavior: A Profile requires an Environment.
topics.impact: Changing this selection affects future launches; existing pods keep captured configuration.

topics.title: AI setup
topics.summary: Choose the main agent, Reviewer and Advisor routes.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the main agent, Reviewer and Advisor routes.
topics.behavior: The selected AI setup owns account/runtime/model choices and backups. Authentication is managed in Provider Accounts.
topics.defaultBehavior: A Profile requires an AI setup.
topics.impact: Changing this selection affects future launches; existing pods keep captured configuration.

topics.title: Workflow
topics.summary: Choose validation, budgets, escalation and delivery policy.
topics.whenToUse: Choose validation, budgets, escalation and delivery policy.
topics.behavior: Repository project setups supply check commands; the task supplies acceptance facts. A Workflow does not contain those commands.
topics.defaultBehavior: A Profile requires a Workflow.
topics.impact: Changing this selection affects future launches; existing pods keep captured configuration.

topics.title: GitHub access
topics.summary: Choose the agent's scoped GitHub broker permissions.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the agent's scoped GitHub broker permissions.
topics.behavior: Access applies to allowed repository operations. Daemon-owned push, PR publication and merge have separate checks and credentials.
topics.defaultBehavior: None means no selected agent GitHub access preset; it does not mean the daemon cannot publish authorized work.
topics.impact: Changing this selection affects future launches; existing pods keep captured configuration.

topics.title: Tool packs
topics.summary: Add reusable tools, connections, skills and agent guidance.
topics.whenToUse: Add reusable tools, connections, skills and agent guidance.
topics.behavior: Selected packs are combined in selection order. Their environment requirements must match declared Environment capabilities. Tool packs do not grant broker permissions.
topics.defaultBehavior: An empty list adds no packs.
topics.impact: Changing this selection affects future launches; existing pods keep captured configuration.

topics.title: Execution backend
topics.summary: Choose daemon-hosted Docker or an Azure sandbox.
topics.whenToUse: Choose daemon-hosted Docker or an Azure sandbox.
topics.behavior: local runs Docker on the connected daemon's host. sandbox uses Azure Container Apps Sandboxes and requires available hosted infrastructure and a compatible image.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default local; availability is reported by the selected daemon.
topics.impact: Backend support controls resource tiers, storage and sidecars.

options.local: Docker on the selected daemon host.
options.sandbox: Azure Container Apps Sandbox; not a local Mac container.

topics.title: Memory (GB)
topics.summary: Set the container's memory cap.
topics.whenToUse: Set the container's memory cap.
topics.behavior: Main-worker values apply to the agent container. Sidecar entries are keyed by an instance ID from the selected Environment; their limits apply separately. Main and sidecars share backend total-allocation constraints.
topics.defaultBehavior: Unset/null uses backend resource defaults. Inspect resolved launch values and backend capabilities rather than assuming a fixed amount.
topics.impact: Too little memory can terminate builds or the agent; larger allocations use more host/hosted capacity.

topics.title: CPU allocation
topics.summary: Set a CPU allocation where the backend can enforce it.
topics.whenToUse: Set a CPU allocation where the backend can enforce it.
topics.behavior: Main-worker values apply to the agent container. Sidecar entries are keyed by an instance ID from the selected Environment; their limits apply separately. Main and sidecars share backend total-allocation constraints.
topics.defaultBehavior: Unset/null uses backend resource defaults. Inspect resolved launch values and backend capabilities rather than assuming a fixed amount.
topics.impact: Unsupported CPU settings are retained for explicit correction, not silently enforced.

topics.title: Storage (GB)
topics.summary: Set a storage allocation where supported.
topics.whenToUse: Set a storage allocation where supported.
topics.behavior: Main-worker values apply to the agent container. Sidecar entries are keyed by an instance ID from the selected Environment; their limits apply separately. Main and sidecars share backend total-allocation constraints.
topics.defaultBehavior: Unset/null uses backend resource defaults. Inspect resolved launch values and backend capabilities rather than assuming a fixed amount.
topics.impact: This is a worker resource limit, not artifact retention or a guarantee of persistent storage.

topics.title: Required sidecars
topics.summary: Start selected on-demand services alongside the worker.
topics.whenToUse: Start selected on-demand services alongside the worker.
topics.behavior: Environment owns definitions and startup modes. Always-start definitions need no Profile toggle; disabled definitions cannot be made runnable by selecting them here.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty selects no additional on-demand instances. It does not disable always-start definitions.
topics.impact: Unknown saved IDs or unsupported services can prevent launch; definitions and resource allocations are distinct.

topics.title: Customize network policy
topics.summary: Override the daemon's default outbound policy.
topics.whenToUse: Override the daemon's default outbound policy.
topics.behavior: A null/absent networkPolicy leaves policy to daemon defaults. Customization creates a policy; enabled=false explicitly disables isolation for that policy.
topics.defaultBehavior: No custom policy uses daemon defaults. Do not equate null with deny-all.
topics.impact: Turning isolation off changes an actual security boundary.

topics.title: Outbound mode
topics.summary: Choose unrestricted, blocked or allowlisted worker egress.
topics.whenToUse: Choose unrestricted, blocked or allowlisted worker egress.
topics.behavior: Restricted mode permits configured hosts with its selected default-host/package-manager additions. Reachability is separate from API permission and credentials.
topics.defaultBehavior: Use the saved policy and daemon capability checks; changing a mode does not grant service authorization.
topics.impact: Denying required control-plane or provider connections can make work unavailable.

options.allow-all: Allow outbound destinations without an allowlist.
options.deny-all: Block outbound destinations under this policy.
options.restricted: Restrict egress to the effective allowlist.

topics.title: Allowed hosts & defaults
topics.summary: Define the destinations a restricted worker can reach.
topics.whenToUse: Define the destinations a restricted worker can reach.
topics.behavior: allowedHosts contains hostnames or supported wildcard hostnames, not full credential-bearing URLs. replaceDefaults=false extends the daemon allowlist; true replaces it. allowPackageManagers adds common registry destinations.
topics.defaultBehavior: Custom hosts normally extend defaults unless replacement is selected. Package-manager access is a separate flag.
topics.impact: Replacing defaults can remove required destinations. Allowlisting a host does not authorize operations on it.

topics.title: Exact PIM assignment
topics.summary: Select a particular eligible assignment for the configured account.
topics.whenToUse: Select a particular eligible assignment for the configured account.
topics.behavior: type distinguishes group, Azure resource role and directory role. tenantId and principalId identify the tenant/account; eligibilityId and roleId identify the eligible assignment/role; scope is the exact resource/directory scope. displayName is descriptive, not authority.
topics.defaultBehavior: No selections means no Profile-requested activations. Eligibility must already exist.
topics.impact: Editing IDs is not a way to create eligibility. Activation can require approval and expire independently.

options.azure-role: Eligible Azure resource role at its scope.

topics.title: PIM timing, duration & justification
topics.summary: Specify when an eligible assignment is requested and for how long.
topics.whenToUse: Specify when an eligible assignment is requested and for how long.
topics.behavior: startup requests activation during startup; when-needed waits until access is needed. duration is an ISO duration such as PT1H. justification records why access is needed; it is not a permission grant.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default timing when-needed and duration PT1H. Saving/previewing a selection does not activate it.
topics.impact: Provider approval, maximum duration and expiry still apply. Do not include secrets in justification.

topics.title: Workspace worker Profile
topics.summary: Choose the launch defaults for workers spawned from a workspace.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the launch defaults for workers spawned from a workspace.
topics.behavior: This selects a child's configuration, not inheritance for the current Profile and not a second main-agent model. The resolver captures the selected worker configuration.
topics.defaultBehavior: None leaves no explicitly selected workspace worker Profile.
topics.impact: Changes affect future child-worker launches; existing frozen workers are unchanged.

topics.title: Main agent
topics.summary: Choose the account, integration and model that perform the work.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the account, integration and model that perform the work.
topics.behavior: Choose the account, integration and model that perform the work.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: An enrolled account supplies authentication/billing; choosing a model alone supplies neither.

topics.summary: Select the AI route for automated review.
topics.whenToUse: Select the AI route for automated review.
topics.behavior: Select the AI route for automated review.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Follow main shares route selection, not a guarantee of independent judgment. Review/Advisor spend share the reviewer and whole-task budgets.

topics.title: Advisor
topics.summary: Select the route for AI consultations, separately from automated review.
topics.whenToUse: Select the route for AI consultations, separately from automated review.
topics.behavior: Select the route for AI consultations, separately from automated review.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Workflow controls whether consultations/proactive advice are enabled; selecting a route alone does not enable them.

topics.title: Failover settings
topics.summary: Configure ordered backup accounts and models for supported failure conditions.
topics.whenToUse: Configure ordered backup accounts and models for supported failure conditions.
topics.behavior: Configure ordered backup accounts and models for supported failure conditions.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Main-agent quota continuation and Reviewer/Advisor call retries have different eligibility rules.

topics.title: Provider account
topics.summary: Choose the enrolled account used for this route.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the enrolled account used for this route.
topics.behavior: Account identity is separate from provider, runtime and model. It must retain valid compatible credentials. Manage sign-in and revocation in Provider Accounts.
topics.defaultBehavior: A complete route needs an explicit compatible account; an unavailable saved ID is not silently substituted.
topics.impact: Route changes affect future launches. Different models/providers can change capability, cost and data handling.

topics.title: Runtime
topics.summary: Choose the agent integration that executes the route.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the agent integration that executes the route.
topics.behavior: Claude, Codex, Copilot and Pi are integrations, not model names. Account/provider compatibility is checked at admission.
topics.defaultBehavior: Choose a supported runtime explicitly; a saved value is not proof of availability.
topics.impact: Route changes affect future launches. Different models/providers can change capability, cost and data handling.

options.pi: Pi integration; provider support depends on the enrolled account.

topics.title: Model
topics.summary: Choose a model supported by the selected account and runtime.
topics.whenToUse: Choose a model supported by the selected account and runtime.
topics.behavior: Use the runtime/provider's model identifier. Similar display names on different providers need not be interchangeable.
topics.defaultBehavior: The configured model is requested explicitly; the UI cannot guarantee provider-side access.
topics.impact: Route changes affect future launches. Different models/providers can change capability, cost and data handling.

topics.title: Reasoning effort
topics.summary: Adjust reasoning work for supported models.
topics.whenToUse: Adjust reasoning work for supported models.
topics.behavior: Higher effort can help difficult tasks while adding latency and token use. Unsupported combinations are not made valid by saving a value.
topics.defaultBehavior: auto uses the runtime default; it does not disable reasoning.
topics.impact: Route changes affect future launches. Different models/providers can change capability, cost and data handling.

topics.title: Reviewer mode
topics.summary: Follow the main route or configure an independent reviewer route.
topics.whenToUse: Follow the main route or configure an independent reviewer route.
topics.behavior: follow-main uses the effective main binding, including applicable continuation. independent selects a complete reviewer account/runtime/model/failover route. Automated task review is enabled by Workflow.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default follow-main.
topics.impact: An independent account/model can reduce shared failure modes, but review is still not a substitute for tests or human authority.

options.independent: Use the reviewer's separately configured route.

topics.title: Advisor mode
topics.summary: Follow main, follow Reviewer, or use an independent consultation route.
topics.whenToUse: Follow main, follow Reviewer, or use an independent consultation route.
topics.behavior: Followed modes reuse the selected route rather than creating hidden independent values. Consultations and review remain different purposes even when their model is shared.
topics.defaultBehavior: Absent Advisor means follow-reviewer; do not materialize a new route merely by opening help.
topics.impact: Reviewer and Advisor share the reviewer sublimit and whole-task accounting.

topics.title: Run & deliver
topics.summary: Choose how work is performed and what the daemon should deliver.
topics.whenToUse: Choose how work is performed and what the daemon should deliver.
topics.behavior: Choose how work is performed and what the daemon should deliver.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Merge requests automatic delivery/merge; provider gates still apply. Review before removing human approval.

topics.title: Token budgets
topics.summary: Bound whole-task usage and the Reviewer/Advisor share.
topics.whenToUse: Bound whole-task usage and the Reviewer/Advisor share.
topics.behavior: Bound whole-task usage and the Reviewer/Advisor share.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Tokens are not dollars or model context-window size. Unset limits do not remove provider limits.

topics.title: Security scans
topics.summary: Detect repository-content risks before work and before push.
topics.whenToUse: Detect repository-content risks before work and before push.
topics.behavior: Detect repository-content risks before work and before push.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: This is distinct from the configured SAST command. Detector thresholds and finding outcomes can block or escalate work.

topics.title: Escalation
topics.summary: Control human questions, AI consultation and blocker pauses.
topics.whenToUse: Control human questions, AI consultation and blocker pauses.
topics.behavior: Control human questions, AI consultation and blocker pauses.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Changing these values can let work continue without a human response; review timeout behavior deliberately.

topics.title: Delivery details
topics.summary: Set branch naming, duplicate-work behavior and finish guidance.
topics.whenToUse: Set branch naming, duplicate-work behavior and finish guidance.
topics.behavior: Set branch naming, duplicate-work behavior and finish guidance.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Changes to shared configuration apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Finish instructions guide the model; they do not grant publication or deployment permission.

topics.title: Agent mode
topics.summary: Choose automatic work or an interactive workspace.
topics.whenToUse: Choose automatic work or an interactive workspace.
topics.behavior: auto runs an agent; interactive is human-driven workspace use. Intent/output/completion combinations must be compatible.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default auto.
topics.impact: An interactive workflow is not an unattended agent run.

topics.title: Task or goal
topics.summary: Choose bounded work or a continuing objective.
topics.whenToUse: Choose bounded work or a continuing objective.
topics.behavior: task is a bounded task. goal requires an automatic agent workflow and a supported native-goal route/backend; objectives have admission limits.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default task.
topics.impact: A goal is not enabled merely by increasing retries or choosing artifact output.

options.goal: Continuing objective subject to goal admission/capabilities.

topics.title: Output
topics.summary: Choose the result the daemon is expected to publish.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the result the daemon is expected to publish.
topics.behavior: pr and branch require an enrolled working repository. artifact publishes task artifacts; none requests no source/artifact delivery target.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default pr.
topics.impact: Output is separate from completion/approval policy.

options.pr: Publish source and a pull request.
options.branch: Publish a branch without requesting PR output.

topics.title: Daemon delivery
topics.summary: Choose where automatic completion stops.
topics.whenToUse: Choose where automatic completion stops.
topics.behavior: approval stops for human approval. deliver requests delivery without automatic merge; merge requests merge subject to all gates. accept-findings is limited to automatic task workflows with artifact/none output and no native validation/advisory QA.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default approval.
topics.impact: This controls daemon delivery, not the agent's prose. It never bypasses unresolved provider policies or permits an unapproved deployment.

options.deliver: Deliver the selected output, without requesting automatic merge.
options.merge: Request merge after applicable checks and external policies.
options.accept-findings: Accept a findings-only task under the restricted findings-workflow contract.

topics.title: Interactive promotion
topics.summary: Allow eligible interactive work to be promoted to an automatic agent run.
topics.whenToUse: Allow eligible interactive work to be promoted to an automatic agent run.
topics.behavior: This makes promotion available; it does not start an agent by itself or rewrite existing launch authority.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default false.
topics.impact: Promotion is a separate user action and must satisfy admission checks.

topics.title: Whole-task and reviewer limits
topics.summary: Limit total measured task usage and the review/consultation share.
topics.whenToUse: Limit total measured task usage and the review/consultation share.
topics.behavior: tokenBudget is the whole-task token allowance. reviewerTokenBudget is a sublimit shared by Reviewer and Advisor; it is not a second independent task budget.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null means no configured whole-task limit or no separate reviewer limit. Provider/model limits still apply.
topics.impact: A lower review sublimit can stop review/consultation even if the task has remaining allowance.

topics.title: Budget warning percentage
topics.summary: Warn before the task exhausts its configured token allowance.
topics.whenToUse: Warn before the task exhausts its configured token allowance.
topics.behavior: tokenBudgetWarnAt is stored as a fraction, displayed as a percentage. It emits a warning, not an extension or hard stop.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default 0.8 (80%); accepted 10–99%.
topics.impact: A warning does not increase the budget.

topics.title: Budget policy & extensions
topics.summary: Choose pause-for-approval or immediate failure at the task limit.
topics.whenToUse: Choose pause-for-approval or immediate failure at the task limit.
topics.behavior: soft pauses for an approved budget extension; hard fails at the limit. maxBudgetExtensions bounds how many extensions may be approved.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default soft; a null extension count is unlimited rather than zero.
topics.impact: Hard limits can stop unfinished work. Extensions are not automatic model/provider quota increases.

options.soft: Pause for approval of an extension.
options.hard: Fail at the configured token limit.

topics.title: Human and AI consultation
topics.summary: Choose whether the agent can ask a human or consult Advisor.
topics.whenToUse: Choose whether the agent can ask a human or consult Advisor.
topics.behavior: askHuman permits human questions. askAi.enabled permits AI consultations with askAi.maxCalls limiting calls (0–50). advisor.enabled enables proactive advice. Composable AI routing comes from AI setup, not the retained legacy askAi.model field.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default human questions on, AI consultation/proactive advice off, maxCalls 5. Null policy uses daemon defaults.
topics.impact: Enabling consultations adds model work; selecting an Advisor route alone does not enable them.

topics.title: Waiting and blocker pauses
topics.summary: Bound repeated blockers and how long human questions wait.
topics.whenToUse: Bound repeated blockers and how long human questions wait.
topics.behavior: autoPauseAfter counts blockers, not validation failures. humanResponseTimeout is seconds (60–86400). askHumanOnTimeout chooses continued best judgment or an AI consultation, subject to consultation availability.
topics.defaultBehavior: Defaults: pause after 3 blockers; wait 3600 seconds; continue on timeout.
topics.impact: Continue can proceed without your answer. Ask-AI behavior still needs an available permitted consultation route.

options.continue: Continue with best judgment after timeout.
options.ask_ai: Reroute the unanswered question to AI consultation where available.

topics.title: Custom content-scan policy
topics.summary: Override the daemon's repository-content scan defaults.
topics.whenToUse: Override the daemon's repository-content scan defaults.
topics.behavior: Null policy uses daemon defaults. Detectors independently enable secrets, personal-data and prompt-injection scanning; optional thresholds express detector confidence, not overall task risk.
topics.defaultBehavior: Desktop customization starts from the default preset: secrets on, optional PII/injection off. Optional thresholds may be omitted for detector defaults.
topics.impact: Turning customization off restores defaults, not a blanket disable. Scans are not proof that all sensitive content was found.

topics.title: Scan checkpoints & outcomes
topics.summary: Choose when content is scanned and what findings do.
topics.whenToUse: Choose when content is scanned and what findings do.
topics.behavior: Provisioning scans before work; push scans before publication. enabled toggles each checkpoint. scope full scans the repository, diff scans changes, auto lets the checkpoint choose. onSecret/onPii/onInjection select finding outcomes independently.
topics.defaultBehavior: Daemon defaults apply without customization; the initial custom preset warns on provisioning secrets and blocks push secrets.
topics.impact: block prevents progress, warn records findings, escalate requires the configured escalation handling. Do not confuse a disabled detector with a clean scan.

topics.title: Always-scanned paths
topics.summary: Include sensitive repository paths even during diff scans.
topics.whenToUse: Include sensitive repository paths even during diff scans.
topics.behavior: Use repository-relative globs for instruction, README or architecture files that need scrutiny regardless of the diff.
topics.defaultBehavior: Omitted uses daemon defaults; an explicitly empty list disables that default path list.
topics.impact: An empty override can reduce scan coverage.

topics.title: Branch prefix
topics.summary: Name automatically generated work branches.
topics.whenToUse: Name automatically generated work branches.
topics.behavior: This prefixes new output branches; it is not a start branch or the PR base branch.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default autopod/.
topics.impact: Changing a prefix does not rename existing branches.

topics.title: Equivalent-work policy
topics.summary: Warn or block when preflight finds equivalent work.
topics.whenToUse: Warn or block when preflight finds equivalent work.
topics.behavior: This is duplicate/equivalent-work admission policy, not a choice of Git conflict-resolution algorithm.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default warn.
topics.impact: Block can prevent duplicate launches; warn does not prove duplicates are safe.

options.block: Reject admission when this policy blocks equivalent work.

topics.title: Merge polling interval
topics.summary: Choose how often PR/provider delivery state is checked.
topics.whenToUse: Choose how often PR/provider delivery state is checked.
topics.behavior: The interval is seconds (5–3600); provider CI/review policies remain authoritative.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default 60 seconds.
topics.impact: Shorter intervals add provider API traffic; they do not make CI run faster.

topics.title: Completion instructions
topics.summary: Give the agent task-finish guidance.
topics.whenToUse: Give the agent task-finish guidance.
topics.behavior: This is finish-stage model guidance before its summary, not the daemon delivery mode and not a reusable Tool-pack rule for the entire session.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null adds no custom finish guidance.
topics.impact: Prose does not authorize push, merge or deployment.

topics.title: Base image
topics.summary: Supply the base image for a custom software environment.
topics.whenToUse: Supply the base image for a custom software environment.
topics.behavior: Use an image compatible with the daemon's supported architecture/tooling. The resolver pins software identity; an image name is not proof of available credentials or hosted pull access.
topics.defaultBehavior: Optional unless required by the chosen custom configuration.
topics.impact: Changing the image can require rebuilding and hosted registry access.

topics.title: Image preparation commands
topics.summary: Install image-level prerequisites in the software recipe.
topics.whenToUse: Install image-level prerequisites in the software recipe.
topics.behavior: These commands prepare reusable image software. Do not put repository checkout-dependent commands here; use Repository Prepare for that, and validation Setup for repeatable check preparation.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty adds no custom image preparation commands.
topics.impact: Operator-authored commands execute during image preparation and can change every future worker using the image.

topics.title: Additional packages
topics.summary: Install extra packages at explicit versions.
topics.whenToUse: Install extra packages at explicit versions.
topics.behavior: name encodes package type/name (pnpm, playwright, npm:, pip: or dotnet: forms); version selects the published version. The UI adds package prefixes. Use exact pins, not latest or ranges.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty relies on template/base-image software.
topics.impact: Extra packages add image build time and dependencies. Removing a declaration does not edit already-running images.

topics.title: Provided capability labels
topics.summary: Declare which Tool-pack requirements this Environment satisfies.
topics.whenToUse: Declare which Tool-pack requirements this Environment satisfies.
topics.behavior: Labels must match requiredCapabilities exactly, including case. They describe software already supplied by the image; they do not install or test packages.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty declares no additional compatibility labels.
topics.impact: A mismatched required label blocks compatible-pack admission even if a binary happens to exist.

topics.title: Sidecar identity & service
topics.summary: Name a service instance and choose its service kind.
topics.whenToUse: Name a service instance and choose its service kind.
topics.behavior: id is the stable instance key used by Profile requirements and resource overrides. type chooses PostgreSQL, Redis or a Dagger engine; version is descriptive service/version configuration, not an image pin.
topics.defaultBehavior: Use a unique supported instance ID; no sidecars are added implicitly by this list.
topics.impact: Renaming an ID can leave saved Profile references unavailable.

options.dagger-engine: Privileged Dagger engine; needs explicit repository trust and backend permission.

topics.title: Digest-pinned sidecar image
topics.summary: Choose the exact service image rather than a mutable tag.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the exact service image rather than a mutable tag.
topics.behavior: image must include an @sha256 digest. The version label alone does not pin bytes or prove service compatibility.
topics.defaultBehavior: An explicit digest-pinned image is required per definition.
topics.impact: Changing an image affects future starts; privileged images still need trust and host permission.

topics.title: Sidecar startup mode
topics.summary: Choose whether the service is disabled, selectable or always started.
topics.whenToUse: Choose whether the service is disabled, selectable or always started.
topics.behavior: Profile/launch requirements select on-demand instances. They cannot make disabled instances runnable, and an empty requirement list does not turn off always-start instances.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default on-demand.
topics.impact: Always-start services consume resources even when a task does not need them.

options.disabled: Unavailable for startup until the definition is enabled.
options.on-demand: Starts when selected by Profile/launch requirements.
options.always: Starts with the Environment without an additional requirement toggle.

topics.title: Sidecar port & health timeout
topics.summary: Tell provisioning where and how long to wait for the service.
topics.whenToUse: Tell provisioning where and how long to wait for the service.
topics.behavior: port is the service's configured port (1–65535), not a promise of a public host port. healthTimeoutMs is milliseconds, unlike Repository check timeouts in seconds.
topics.defaultBehavior: Health timeout defaults to 60000 ms (60 seconds).
topics.impact: A service that never becomes healthy can prevent provisioning; this is not the app's web health check.

topics.title: Tool-pack CLI tools
topics.summary: Install named executables and provide guidance for using them.
topics.whenToUse: Install named executables and provide guidance for using them.
topics.behavior: Install named executables and provide guidance for using them.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Shared changes apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Installation is real software execution; selecting a CLI does not grant credentials or broker permissions.

topics.title: Skills & MCP
topics.summary: Add named procedures and tool-server connections for the agent.
topics.whenToUse: Add named procedures and tool-server connections for the agent.
topics.behavior: Add named procedures and tool-server connections for the agent.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Shared changes apply to future launches.
topics.impact: These do not automatically exist in every local assistant or worker. Resolve prerequisites and scoped credentials explicitly.

topics.title: Tool-pack compatibility
topics.summary: Declare the Environment labels this pack needs.
topics.whenToUse: Declare the Environment labels this pack needs.
topics.behavior: Declare the Environment labels this pack needs.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Shared changes apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Exact-match requirements validate compatibility; selecting labels installs nothing.

topics.title: CLI identity & guidance
topics.summary: Name the command on PATH and explain when and how to use it.
topics.whenToUse: Name the command on PATH and explain when and how to use it.
topics.behavior: name is the exposed executable; description is its purpose; instructions should include prerequisites, examples and side effects. usage influences model-facing guidance, not enforced mandatory execution.
topics.defaultBehavior: usage defaults to instructed. Empty CLI list installs none.
topics.impact: Guidance is not an execution audit. Authentication and permissions remain separately configured.

options.discretionary: Present the tool for discretionary use; not a forced execution.

topics.title: CLI verification & requirements
topics.summary: Check installation with a safe offline probe and declare prerequisites.
topics.whenToUse: Check installation with a safe offline probe and declare prerequisites.
topics.behavior: verifyArgs is an argument array such as --help; use a non-mutating command requiring no provider login. requiredCapabilities declares exact Environment labels needed by this executable.
topics.defaultBehavior: Verification arguments are required; an empty requirements list adds no capability constraint.
topics.impact: Do not put deployment, login or mutation commands in verification.

topics.title: CLI installation source
topics.summary: Choose a pinned public package, source checkout or release asset.
topics.whenToUse: Choose a pinned public package, source checkout or release asset.
topics.behavior: npm uses package/version/executable; github-source uses repository/full commit/build commands/executable path; github-release uses repository/tag and platform-specific checksum-pinned assets.
topics.defaultBehavior: An explicit supported source is required for each selected CLI.
topics.impact: These are trusted operator-authored software recipes, not arbitrary credential-bearing download URLs.

options.github-source: Public GitHub source at a full commit, built using trusted commands.
options.github-release: Public GitHub release asset verified by platform/checksum.

topics.title: Package, version & executable
topics.summary: Identify the exact package bytes and the binary to expose.
topics.whenToUse: Identify the exact package bytes and the binary to expose.
topics.behavior: For npm, package is the registry package name, version is an exact version and executable is its package command. Source-checkout executable instead names a safe relative file in that checkout.
topics.defaultBehavior: No mutable latest/range or automatic executable inference.
topics.impact: Source kind determines the meaning of executable; a package name need not equal its binary name.

topics.title: GitHub source and release pins
topics.summary: Identify public source/release inputs unambiguously.
topics.whenToUse: Identify public source/release inputs unambiguously.
topics.behavior: repository is owner/name. github-source commit is a full 40-character SHA and buildCommands execute trusted build steps. github-release tag selects the release; its asset checksums pin bytes.
topics.defaultBehavior: Source builds require explicit commands and executable; releases require matching platform assets.
topics.impact: Build commands execute operator-trusted code. A mutable release tag alone is not an integrity check.

topics.title: Platform assets & archive member
topics.summary: Select the Linux asset and verify its SHA-256 before use.
topics.whenToUse: Select the Linux asset and verify its SHA-256 before use.
topics.behavior: platform selects linux/amd64 or linux/arm64. asset is the release filename; sha256 is its expected digest. format binary means a raw executable; tar.gz additionally requires a safe executable member path inside the archive.
topics.defaultBehavior: Only matching, supported, checksum-verified assets are usable. Raw binaries have no archive member.
topics.impact: Checksums detect changed downloads; they do not make untrusted software safe.

options.tar.gz: Compressed archive; select the exact executable member.

topics.title: Skill name & description
topics.summary: Expose a named reusable procedure and its purpose.
topics.whenToUse: Expose a named reusable procedure and its purpose.
topics.behavior: name identifies the skill; description helps explain its use. Skills differ from always-included Tool-pack instruction sections and installed executable CLIs.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty list adds no skills; optional description may be omitted.
topics.impact: A skill's existence is not proof it was invoked. User-global planning skills are not automatically daemon builtins.

topics.title: Skill source & resolved content
topics.summary: Choose where the skill procedure is obtained.
topics.whenToUse: Choose where the skill procedure is obtained.
topics.behavior: builtin must exist in current daemon discovery; inline stores content here; local path is on the daemon, not this Mac; github selects an enrolled repository, relative file path and ref. Source content is resolved for a captured launch.
topics.defaultBehavior: No content is fetched merely by opening help. Missing/removed builtins need explicit reconfiguration.
topics.impact: Repository/ref or daemon-local path access must be available; do not paste secrets into skill content.

options.inline: Procedure text stored in the pack.
options.local: File path on the daemon host.
options.github: File from an enrolled repository at the selected branch/tag/commit.

topics.title: MCP name & transport
topics.summary: Connect the agent to a tool server through a named integration.
topics.whenToUse: Connect the agent to a tool server through a named integration.
topics.behavior: name identifies the server. HTTP uses a server URL and headers; stdio starts the configured command with arguments/environment through runtime provisioning. Neither mode installs missing software by itself.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty list adds no extra MCP connections.
topics.impact: Tool-server capability is not an authorization grant; backend, network and credential constraints still apply.

options.http: Connect to a supported HTTP MCP endpoint.
options.stdio: Start a command-based MCP server with explicit arguments/environment.

topics.title: MCP endpoint, command & arguments
topics.summary: Supply the tool-server destination or executable invocation.
topics.whenToUse: Supply the tool-server destination or executable invocation.
topics.behavior: HTTP url is an HTTP(S) endpoint without embedded credentials/query/fragment. stdio command/args are an explicit executable and argument array, not a magic shell install recipe.
topics.defaultBehavior: Use only the fields for the selected transport; an unavailable executable/endpoint cannot be repaired by naming a server.
topics.impact: HTTP requires network reachability; command mode requires compatible installed software in the execution environment.

topics.title: MCP headers & command environment
topics.summary: Provide literal values or enrolled credential references to this integration.
topics.whenToUse: Provide literal values or enrolled credential references to this integration.
topics.behavior: HTTP headers are sent to that server. stdio env is passed to that command. value is literal text; secretId references a scoped enrolled credential resolved by the daemon.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty maps add no values. A missing or unauthorized credential reference does not become a plaintext fallback.
topics.impact: Keep secret contents out of ordinary values/URLs and help text; references do not grant access.

topics.title: Required Environment labels
topics.summary: Require an Environment that declares every selected capability.
topics.whenToUse: Require an Environment that declares every selected capability.
topics.behavior: Matching is exact and case-sensitive. Labels express compatibility requirements; they do not install packages, check binaries or grant access.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty imposes no pack-level label requirements; CLI-specific requirements may still apply.
topics.impact: Use Environment software to install prerequisites and Access for authorization.

topics.title: GitHub broker access
topics.summary: Scope the agent's GitHub operations to repositories, workflows and branches.
topics.whenToUse: Scope the agent's GitHub operations to repositories, workflows and branches.
topics.behavior: Scope the agent's GitHub operations to repositories, workflows and branches.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Shared changes apply to future launches.
topics.impact: Broad all/owner scopes expand authority. Daemon publication credentials are separate and are not handed to the agent.

topics.title: Rule ID
topics.summary: Identify a reusable permission rule.
topics.whenToUse: Identify a reusable permission rule.
topics.behavior: The ID distinguishes rules in the preset; it is not a GitHub credential or repository permission by itself.
topics.defaultBehavior: Use a stable unique rule ID.
topics.impact: Renaming identifiers is not a method for broadening allowed operations.

topics.title: Repository scope
topics.summary: Choose current, selected or owner-scoped repositories.
topics.whenToUse: Choose current, selected or owner-scoped repositories.
topics.behavior: current means the launch's working repository. selected uses explicit repository IDs. owner uses ownerId/ownerLogin with all or selected repositories under that owner. IDs bind authority; display names are descriptive.
topics.defaultBehavior: Explicit selections are retained and checked against available discovery/permissions.
topics.impact: Owner-wide/all scopes can include more repositories than the immediate task needs.

options.all: All accessible repositories within that owner scope.

topics.title: Allowed GitHub operations
topics.summary: Choose precisely what the agent may request through the broker.
topics.whenToUse: Choose precisely what the agent may request through the broker.
topics.behavior: Read operations expose code/issues/PRs/actions. Issue mutations, comments, workflow dispatch and run rerun/cancel are separate grants. None grants direct push/merge credentials.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty grants no listed operations.
topics.impact: Write, dispatch and cancellation operations can affect other people, CI execution and cost.

topics.title: Allowed workflows
topics.summary: Narrow workflow-related operations to reviewed workflow files.
topics.whenToUse: Narrow workflow-related operations to reviewed workflow files.
topics.behavior: workflows all covers available workflows under the repository scope; selected stores repositoryId/path/workflowId bindings. Paths name .github/workflows files; discovery binds the provider workflow identity.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default selected with an empty file list.
topics.impact: Allowing a workflow does not grant dispatch/rerun/cancel unless its operation is also selected.

options.all: All workflows within the permitted repository scope.

topics.title: Allowed branches
topics.summary: Constrain branch-sensitive broker operations.
topics.whenToUse: Constrain branch-sensitive broker operations.
topics.behavior: all permits branches within the rule's other scopes; selected names exact branches. Globs such as feature/* are not accepted as exact selected names.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default selected with an empty list.
topics.impact: Branch allowance is not permission to publish or merge arbitrary code.

options.all: All branches within the remaining scope.

topics.title: Shared package feed
topics.summary: Configure reusable npm/NuGet installation access for Repository setups.
topics.whenToUse: Configure reusable npm/NuGet installation access for Repository setups.
topics.behavior: Configure reusable npm/NuGet installation access for Repository setups.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help keeps saved values unchanged. Shared changes apply to future launches.
topics.impact: A saved feed is not automatically selected in every repository. Credentials remain enrolled on the daemon.

topics.title: Feed type
topics.summary: Choose the package-manager configuration to generate.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the package-manager configuration to generate.
topics.behavior: npm and NuGet have different registry configuration formats. npm scope applies only to npm feeds.
topics.defaultBehavior: An explicit supported feed type is required.
topics.impact: Wrong feed type will not make authentication or package resolution compatible.

topics.title: Registry URL
topics.summary: Name the HTTPS package feed endpoint.
topics.whenToUse: Name the HTTPS package feed endpoint.
topics.behavior: Use HTTPS without credentials, whitespace, query or fragment. Keep token contents in an enrolled credential, not the URL.
topics.defaultBehavior: A registry URL is required.
topics.impact: The worker also needs permitted network access and compatible package-manager software.

topics.title: npm scope
topics.summary: Limit an npm registry mapping to a package scope.
topics.whenToUse: Limit an npm registry mapping to a package scope.
topics.behavior: Use a scope such as @company. This is package routing, not GitHub/repository permission. NuGet feeds do not accept npm scope.
topics.defaultBehavior: Omitted has no npm scope qualifier.
topics.impact: An incorrect scope can route package installation to the wrong feed.

topics.title: Credential reference & expiry
topics.summary: Select an enrolled registry credential and track its expiry.
topics.whenToUse: Select an enrolled registry credential and track its expiry.
topics.behavior: credential.secretId references write-only encrypted credential storage. expiresAt is YYYY-MM-DD metadata for availability checks. Sign-in/test results do not prove an actual package installation.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null supports feeds without an enrolled credential; omitted expiry adds no expiry metadata.
topics.impact: Rotation/revocation affects credential availability; it does not automatically resume paused pods.

topics.title: Repository identity & defaults
topics.summary: Enroll source identity and select its usual Profile and project setup.
topics.whenToUse: Enroll source identity and select its usual Profile and project setup.
topics.behavior: Enroll source identity and select its usual Profile and project setup.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: Repository identity is separate from a Profile; several project setups can share the same source.

topics.title: Project setups
topics.summary: Define repository-specific commands, web checks, variables and integrations.
topics.whenToUse: Define repository-specific commands, web checks, variables and integrations.
topics.behavior: Define repository-specific commands, web checks, variables and integrations.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: Workflow decides which checks run; the selected project setup supplies their actual configuration.

topics.title: Trust & identity
topics.summary: Bind repository identity and explicitly trust reviewed project setups.
topics.whenToUse: Bind repository identity and explicitly trust reviewed project setups.
topics.behavior: Bind repository identity and explicitly trust reviewed project setups.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: Trust can authorize privileged sidecars when the host also permits them; it is not a generic safe-repository badge.

topics.title: Repository commands
topics.summary: Separate checkout preparation from validation setup and build/test/start commands.
topics.whenToUse: Separate checkout preparation from validation setup and build/test/start commands.
topics.behavior: Separate checkout preparation from validation setup and build/test/start commands.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: Commands execute inside the worker; keep prerequisites, working directories and environment recipients explicit.

topics.whenToUse: Configure web readiness and time limits consumed by Workflow validation.
topics.behavior: Configure web readiness and time limits consumed by Workflow validation.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: A timeout is not a retry count, and a configured target does not enable its check.

topics.whenToUse: Describe deterministic browser paths and CSS assertions.
topics.behavior: Describe deterministic browser paths and CSS assertions.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: Pages depend on passing App health and a browser-capable validation environment.

topics.summary: Pass literal values or scoped credential references to repository command execution.
topics.whenToUse: Pass literal values or scoped credential references to repository command execution.
topics.behavior: Pass literal values or scoped credential references to repository command execution.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: This is not the agent's universal runtime environment or the deployment environment.

topics.title: PR provider & package feeds
topics.summary: Select delivery provider and installation feed access for this setup.
topics.whenToUse: Select delivery provider and installation feed access for this setup.
topics.behavior: Select delivery provider and installation feed access for this setup.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: Shared feeds are enrolled separately. Avoid duplicate inline and shared registry entries.

topics.title: Service read access
topics.summary: Scope ADO reads and Azure log queries through the daemon broker.
topics.whenToUse: Scope ADO reads and Azure log queries through the daemon broker.
topics.behavior: Scope ADO reads and Azure log queries through the daemon broker.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: These are constrained service rules, not arbitrary HTTP credentials or permission to mutate external systems.

topics.title: Repository deployment
topics.summary: Allow an enrolled target to deploy reviewed published-default source.
topics.whenToUse: Allow an enrolled target to deploy reviewed published-default source.
topics.behavior: Allow an enrolled target to deploy reviewed published-default source.
topics.defaultBehavior: Opening help leaves settings unchanged. Review the selected context before saving or acting.
topics.impact: Enabling a setup is not approval to execute a deployment; target policy and human approval remain separate.

topics.title: Source provider
topics.summary: Choose GitHub, Azure DevOps or generic Git source identity.
topics.whenToUse: Choose GitHub, Azure DevOps or generic Git source identity.
topics.behavior: This identifies the repository provider, not necessarily every downstream service or model provider. Setup PR provider is a separate integration choice.
topics.defaultBehavior: An explicit provider is required.
topics.impact: Generic Git identity alone does not supply GitHub/ADO PR authorization.

options.git: Generic Git source without implied GitHub/ADO identity.

topics.title: Repository remote & stable provider ID
topics.summary: Bind source location without embedding credentials.
topics.whenToUse: Bind source location without embedding credentials.
topics.behavior: remote is an HTTP(S) repository URL without credentials/query/fragment. providerRepositoryId records stable provider identity so a renamed/reused URL cannot silently change the repository.
topics.defaultBehavior: Provider identity may be null when unavailable; discovery records it where supported.
topics.impact: Changing source identity affects future checkouts and must not silently retarget existing authority.

topics.title: Default Profile & project setup
topics.summary: Choose the usual launch combination for this repository.
topics.whenToUse: Choose the usual launch combination for this repository.
topics.behavior: usualProfileId selects a saved Profile when none is explicitly chosen. defaultSetupId identifies one of this repository's named setups. Overrides at launch are separate.
topics.defaultBehavior: A default setup must exist; no usual Profile means a launch must obtain a Profile through another explicit selection.
topics.impact: Changing defaults affects future launches, watchers/schedules that resolve defaults and other consumers; captured pods stay frozen.

topics.title: Trusted project setups
topics.summary: Permit privileged service definitions only for reviewed setups.
topics.whenToUse: Permit privileged service definitions only for reviewed setups.
topics.behavior: trustedSetupIds names setups in this repository. Host/backend permission is also required for privileged sidecars; trust does not bypass it.
topics.defaultBehavior: Empty trusts no project setups for this purpose.
topics.impact: Trust is authority. Review definitions before adding a setup; never broaden it just to make a launch pass.

topics.title: Setup ID, name & default branch
topics.summary: Identify a project's commands and ordinary source branch.
topics.whenToUse: Identify a project's commands and ordinary source branch.
topics.behavior: id is the stable setup key; name is descriptive. defaultBranch supplies the ordinary branch for this setup, not an automatic output-branch name.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default branch main; each repository needs at least one setup with valid default/trust references.
topics.impact: Removing or renaming an ID can invalidate saved launch selections. Default/trusted setups must be reselected before removal.

topics.title: Working directory
topics.summary: Run project-specific commands in the right repository subdirectory.
topics.whenToUse: Run project-specific commands in the right repository subdirectory.
topics.behavior: buildWorkDir is a safe relative directory under /workspace for build/test/lint/SAST/start/facts and repository Prepare. Validation Setup currently executes at /workspace (repository root), so write that command accordingly.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null uses repository root. Absolute paths/traversal are not accepted.
topics.impact: A monorepo command can target the wrong package if its working directory is assumed.

topics.title: Repository Prepare command
topics.summary: Prepare source-dependent dependencies after checkout and feed setup.
topics.whenToUse: Prepare source-dependent dependencies after checkout and feed setup.
topics.behavior: prepareCommand runs inside this pod before the agent begins using checked-out source, in buildWorkDir when selected. This differs from Environment image preparation and pre-validation Setup.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null runs no repository Prepare command; it uses the setup's build timeout when present.
topics.impact: This command executes repository-dependent work and can fail provisioning. It is not controlled by the Workflow's Setup checkbox.

topics.title: Validation Setup command
topics.summary: Repeat preparation before the configured blocking checks.
topics.whenToUse: Repeat preparation before the configured blocking checks.
topics.behavior: validationSetupCommand is the optional Setup phase selected by Workflow. It runs at repository root and uses the build timeout.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null skips optional validation Setup even when its phase is selected.
topics.impact: Use repeatable check preparation, not deployment or image-level installation.

topics.title: Lint command
topics.summary: Run the project's code-style and quality checks.
topics.whenToUse: Run the project's code-style and quality checks.
topics.behavior: Workflow enables the corresponding phase; this setup supplies the actual command. Composable launch admission rejects a selected phase when its required command is missing. The command runs in buildWorkDir (or repository root) with scoped build variables.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null stores no command. It does not automatically infer an npm/dotnet/etc command.
topics.impact: Exit status, phase timeout and infrastructure classification determine the result; naming a command does not prove it passed.

topics.title: SAST command
topics.summary: Run the project's static source-security scanner.
topics.whenToUse: Run the project's static source-security scanner.
topics.behavior: Workflow enables the corresponding phase; this setup supplies the actual command. Composable launch admission rejects a selected phase when its required command is missing. The command runs in buildWorkDir (or repository root) with scoped build variables.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null stores no command. It does not automatically infer an npm/dotnet/etc command.
topics.impact: Exit status, phase timeout and infrastructure classification determine the result; naming a command does not prove it passed.

topics.title: Build command
topics.summary: Compile or build the selected project.
topics.whenToUse: Compile or build the selected project.
topics.behavior: Workflow enables the corresponding phase; this setup supplies the actual command. Composable launch admission rejects a selected phase when its required command is missing. The command runs in buildWorkDir (or repository root) with scoped build variables.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null stores no command. It does not automatically infer an npm/dotnet/etc command.
topics.impact: Exit status, phase timeout and infrastructure classification determine the result; naming a command does not prove it passed.

topics.title: Test command
topics.summary: Run the project's chosen automated test suite.
topics.whenToUse: Run the project's chosen automated test suite.
topics.behavior: Workflow enables the corresponding phase; this setup supplies the actual command. Composable launch admission rejects a selected phase when its required command is missing. The command runs in buildWorkDir (or repository root) with scoped build variables.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null stores no command. It does not automatically infer an npm/dotnet/etc command.
topics.impact: Exit status, phase timeout and infrastructure classification determine the result; naming a command does not prove it passed.

topics.title: Start command
topics.summary: Start the app for Health and browser-related validation.
topics.whenToUse: Start the app for Health and browser-related validation.
topics.behavior: Use the app's configured worker port and compatible startup command. Health must pass before smoke pages can execute.
topics.defaultBehavior: Null stores no startup command; selected web validation requires one at admission.
topics.impact: Starting a process is not deployment, public exposure or proof that the app stays healthy.

topics.title: Web UI & health endpoint
topics.summary: Declare web applicability and the HTTP readiness path.
topics.whenToUse: Declare web applicability and the HTTP readiness path.
topics.behavior: hasWebUi=false skips web checks at runtime. healthPath is a URL path such as /health, not a full external service URL. Health probes need app startup and a successful build result.
topics.defaultBehavior: hasWebUi defaults true; healthPath defaults /. Clearing path stores null rather than a path string.
topics.impact: These settings do not enable Health/Pages in Workflow, and a selected web phase may still require a start command even for an inapplicable project.

topics.title: Build / preparation timeout
topics.summary: Bound how long this phase may wait, in seconds.
topics.whenToUse: Bound how long this phase may wait, in seconds.
topics.behavior: This limit also bounds repository Prepare and validation Setup, not only build.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default 300 seconds; allowed 1–86400. Reset omits the key to use the daemon default.
topics.impact: A longer wait may consume more worker capacity; it does not repair a hung process.

topics.title: Test timeout
topics.summary: Bound how long this phase may wait, in seconds.
topics.whenToUse: Bound how long this phase may wait, in seconds.
topics.behavior: This is a duration limit for the configured check, not the validation-attempt count.
topics.defaultBehavior: Default 600 seconds; allowed 1–86400. Reset omits the key to use the daemon default.
topics.impact: A longer wait may consume more worker capacity; it does not repair a hung process.

topics.title: Lint timeout
topics.summary: Bound how long this phase may wait, in seconds.

topics.summary: Add read-only source context beside the working repository.

topics.behavior: Add read-only source context beside the working repository.

topics.impact: Reference material is not an additional writable task repository or permission to publish it.

topics.impact: JSON errors apply nothing. Task/source/work and request identity are distinct from reusable settings.

topics.title: Building-block selection
topics.summary: Select saved blocks without changing their shared source records.
topics.whenToUse: Select saved blocks without changing their shared source records.
topics.behavior: Selection replaces that category's saved source. Category overrides are launch-only patches. Optional GitHub access can be explicitly null; Tool packs can be explicitly [].
topics.defaultBehavior: Omitted selections use the Profile. Resetting to Profile defaults clears the launch choice, not the saved block.
topics.impact: A later edit invalidates Preview. Effective names and source ownership are shown by resolved Preview.

topics.title: Memory
topics.summary: Memory allocation for this launch's main worker or a selected sidecar.
topics.whenToUse: Memory allocation for this launch's main worker or a selected sidecar.
topics.behavior: Memory allocation is validated against the selected backend's current capabilities. Values use GB. Main and sidecars count toward shared limits.
topics.defaultBehavior: Main: omitted fields retain Profile allocation. Supplying a sidecars map replaces the Profile map; omitted sidecar allocations use backend defaults. Explicit null requests backend defaults. Switching backend clears incompatible choices.
topics.impact: Higher allocations may cost more; unsupported sizes or combined limits block launch.

topics.whenToUse: CPU allocation for this launch's main worker or a selected sidecar.
topics.behavior: CPU allocation is validated against the selected backend's current capabilities. Values use CPUs. Main and sidecars count toward shared limits.
topics.defaultBehavior: Main: omitted fields retain Profile allocation. Supplying a sidecars map replaces the Profile map; omitted sidecar allocations use backend defaults. Explicit null requests backend defaults. Switching backend clears incompatible choices.
topics.impact: Higher allocations may cost more; unsupported sizes or combined limits block launch.

topics.title: Storage
topics.summary: Writable storage allocation for this launch's main worker or a selected sidecar.
topics.whenToUse: Writable storage allocation for this launch's main worker or a selected sidecar.

topics.defaultBehavior: Main: omitted fields retain Profile allocation. Supplying a sidecars map replaces the Profile map; omitted sidecar allocations use backend defaults. Explicit null requests backend defaults. Switching backend clears incompatible choices.
topics.impact: Higher allocations may cost more; unsupported sizes or combined limits block launch.

topics.title: Run in
topics.summary: Choose where the worker runs for this launch.
topics.whenToUse: Choose where the worker runs for this launch.
topics.behavior: Docker means the selected daemon's Docker host—not necessarily this Mac. Hosted sandbox requires daemon support and does not support sidecars.
topics.defaultBehavior: Omission uses the Profile target; switching targets resets incompatible allocation fields.
topics.impact: Backend changes alter capabilities and cost.

options.local: Docker on the selected daemon host.

topics.title: Required sidecars
topics.summary: Select which eligible Environment services are required by this task.
topics.whenToUse: Select which eligible Environment services are required by this task.
topics.behavior: Always-start services remain included. On-demand services can be required before task execution. Disabled services cannot be selected; hosted sandbox does not support sidecars.
topics.defaultBehavior: Omitted selection uses Profile requirements; explicit [] removes optional requirements, not always-start services.
topics.impact: Required sidecars consume shared resources and may delay readiness.

topics.title: PIM selections
topics.summary: Use Profile roles or specify launch-specific eligible access.
topics.whenToUse: Use Profile roles or specify launch-specific eligible access.
topics.behavior: Select eligible roles from the configured account and supply their duration/justification. Discovery and saving selections do not activate roles.
topics.defaultBehavior: Omitted override retains Profile PIM selections; explicit [] removes the launch requirements.
topics.impact: Revalidation and authority checks still apply. This does not grant eligibility or switch account.

topics.title: Reference repositories
topics.summary: Choose extra read-only repositories and the refs to read.
topics.whenToUse: Choose extra read-only repositories and the refs to read.
topics.behavior: Each entry selects a registered Repository, a nonempty branch/tag/ref and read access. At most 16 can be attached. They provide source context, not additional writable publication targets.
topics.defaultBehavior: An omitted/empty list adds no reference repositories.
topics.impact: Source contents may reach the selected agent/provider; respect information boundaries.

options.read: Read-only context, not a writable task checkout.

topics.title: Task-specific work inputs
topics.summary: Work holds contracts, dependencies and handoff context.
topics.whenToUse: Work holds contracts, dependencies and handoff context.
topics.behavior: These are task inputs, not reusable Profile defaults. Contract requiredFacts drive Facts validation. Dependencies/PR mode affect series scheduling and publication; work.waitForMerge can defer execution until the relevant parent merge.
topics.defaultBehavior: Omitted inputs add no extra requirements; source/series defaults and final admission rules still apply.
topics.impact: References and handoff text are context, not permission. Do not put secrets into task text or attachments.

options.single: One PR for the complete series.
options.stacked: One PR per pod; dependent pods wait for merge as configured.
options.none: Branch-only series output rather than automatic series PR creation.

topics.title: Follow-up configuration source
topics.summary: Select which configuration a follow-up should resolve from its source pod.
topics.whenToUse: When starting related work from an existing pod.
topics.behavior: A source pod ID, reviewed digest and configuration choice bind the follow-up context. Preview resolves the supported source instead of assuming current presets and captured values are identical.
topics.defaultBehavior: Without a follow-up source, launch uses its ordinary Repository/Profile selection.
topics.impact: Revalidate the exact source in Preview; choosing a source is not permission to publish or to replay a changed request.

options.original: Request the source pod's captured original configuration.
options.worker: Request recorded worker configuration where supported and available; not arbitrary host state.
